title: Journalism-Guided Agentic In-Context Learning for News Stance Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Applying an LLM-based article-level stance detection model (JOA-ICL) to classify news articles as supportive, neutral, or oppositional on specific socio-political issues, and mapping the distribution of these predicted stances across major news outlets to reveal partisan media bias aligned with their known progressive or conservative editorial leanings.
